# brig upgrade

Move a VM onto a newer base image, keeping its data

## Synopsis

```text
brig upgrade [NAME]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--allow-minor` | allow an OpenShell minor version change |
| `--image string` | base image ID (default: newest) |
| `-o, --output format` | output format: table or json (default `table`) |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
